name: Blackberries
description: Blackberries represent a highly sophisticated, fibrous botanical aggregate matrix. They boast an exceptional concentration of structural non-starch polysaccharides and polyphenolic compounds, notably *cyanidin-3-glucoside* and hydrolyzable *ellagitannins*. These bio-actives interface with the intestinal epithelium to support optimal microbiome ecology, cross physiological barriers to modulate neuro-inflammatory pathways, and exert notable astringent properties within mammalian tissue systems.
macroIntro: The macronutrient design of raw blackberries is defined by a low glycemic payload tightly bound within an aggressive, high-density matrix of insoluble and soluble dietary fibers.
microIntro: Blackberries deliver a highly bioavailable complex of fat-soluble and water-soluble vitamin cofactors alongside active phenolic polymers engineered to sustain skeletal integrity and block oxidative cascades.

macroNutrients.name: Calories
macroNutrients.description: A remarkably minimalist caloric density, creating an efficient vehicle for therapeutic phytonutrient loading without burdening metabolic energy expenditure.

macroNutrients.name: Protein
macroNutrients.description: Contains a notable distribution of plant-derived amino acids embedded within the berry's complex structural seed and flesh elements.

macroNutrients.name: Total Fat
macroNutrients.description: Consists primarily of trace essential fatty acid fractions sequestered within the seed architecture, leaving peripheral lipid pathways unencumbered.

macroNutrients.name: Carbohydrates
macroNutrients.description: Characterized by low-impact monosaccharides balanced by a massive 5.3-gram functional fiber network, severely blunting the systemic glycemic response.

microNutrients.name: Vitamin C (Ascorbic Acid)
microNutrients.description: Serves as a vital water-soluble electron donor, catalyzing endogenous collagen cross-linking and fortifying leukocyte immune response protocols.

microNutrients.name: Vitamin K (Phylloquinone)
microNutrients.description: An essential cofactor required for the hepatic gamma-carboxylation of clotting factors and the optimal activation of osteocalcin for bone matrix mineralization.

healthBenefits: Gastrointestinal Motility & Microbiome Support: The dual presence of soluble pectin and insoluble cellulose speeds intestinal transit times, mechanical cleansing of the mucosal walls, and feeds short-chain fatty acid (SCFA) producing colonic bacteria.

Neuro-Inflammatory Mitigation: High-potency *anthocyanins* and polyphenols systematically damp down pro-inflammatory cytokines in microglia, maintaining synaptic signal plasticity and defending against accelerated brain aging loops.

Oral Pathogen Suppression & Tissue Astringency: Natural *gallotannins* display direct antimicrobial efficacy against cariogenic bacteria like *Streptococcus mutans*, while reinforcing gingival matrix tight junctions.

Glycemic Regulating Dynamics: The high fiber-to-sugar ratio dramatically slows gastric emptying, delaying intestinal alpha-glucosidase activity to ensure smooth, sustained energy delivery without insulin surges.
precautionsIntro: Despite the therapeutic, high-fiber profile of raw blackberries, specific structural compounds and standard agricultural realities demand target consumption awareness.
precautions: Gastrointestinal Distress from Tannin Loads: The elevated concentration of native astringent tannins can cause localized mucosal irritation, nausea, or mild cramps in individuals with highly sensitive stomach lining architecture.

Oxalate and Salicylate Sensitivity Pathways: Contains moderate organic plant compounds that may trigger adverse histaminic or hyper-sensitive cascades in individuals susceptible to botanical salicylates.

Porous Surface Pesticide Accumulation: The intricate composite drupelet architecture easily traps and retains environmental debris and chemical residues. Utilizing thorough physical washing or organic options is strongly advised.
Rapid Fiber Influx Adaptation: An abrupt, massive escalation in blackberry intake can overwhelm an unconditioned digestive system, culminating in temporary osmotic shifts, flatulence, or bloating.
